_about: Queue ranking. The queue sorts by danger score (highest first), never by arrival time. Weights are chosen so each tier outranks everything below it combined: blocked > allergy conflict > controlled-substance issue > high-alert drug > look-alike risk > other flags.

blocked.why: Prompt injection or a missing page: nobody may act on this fax until a person has handled it.

allergy_conflict.why: A documented allergy to the drug's class can cause immediate patient harm if filled.

controlled_substance_issue.why: Invalid or missing DEA registration, or refills the law does not allow (21 CFR 1306.12 / 1306.22): legal risk and possible diversion or forgery.

high_alert_drug.why: Drug is in an ISMP community high-alert category (faxfill/ref/high_alert.json, manual source); errors with these drugs are more likely to cause serious harm. Applied only when the order has at least one flag.

lookalike_risk.why: The name may actually be its look-alike/sound-alike partner.

other_flag.why: Every other flagged field adds a little, capped so many minor flags never outrank one look-alike risk.
